verdict.rationale: Sentry ships Seer, its own AI debugging agent, so whether external MCP servers can be plugged in as tools is a fair question here. The evidence never shows Seer or Sentry acting as an MCP client. The Sentry MCP server (mcp.sentry.dev) is the server role, which is a different story. MCP server monitoring only observes a user's own MCP pipelines and is adjacent, not client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
